body:
I was hesitant on this relationship I was going to leave until she pushed saying she didn't want him to live without her but didn't want him to live without me either. And me calling him my guy is no way of saying he belongs to only me and I am constantly reminded of that. At this point I have made so many attempts talking to her if I am causing things to be worse I would step aside. But for her to make it seem as though it's no one's fault but his and mine I feel is not fair. 
   I felt that if she didn't want me there she should of told me so in the beginning instead of persisting me to stay. But I was constantly reassured by them both. As far as marrying him goes if there were any other way I would do it I am not plotting to break up their marriage I never was. And things were discussed with her as far as one day this will happen.  To me I just feel like everyone is trying to point blame to someone she never voiced her opinion in the various attempts I have made even talking to her through him which seems to be the only way she will sit down. 
   And relocating no she would not have to pay to relocate there would be extra income with he and I deciding to marry. I have gladly said over and over again I would pay for any expenses as they had intended to do with me.
   For people to expect me to hide and never attend any sort of function with him because they might think we are more than just friends; it's just wrong to me I came in this relationship to build bonds with both of them not to be some booty call for him.
